# Rohit Shirke

> Senior Software Engineer and AI specialist based in Mumbai, with 10+ years building backend systems, distributed services, and AI-native products. Formerly with Shaadi.com. Writes about LLM applications, RAG, agentic workflows, evaluation pipelines, and practical software architecture.

This site contains an about section, technical writing, a bookshelf, personal projects, and a live feed of recent public posts.

## Site

- [Home](https://shirkerohit.github.io/): Introduction, selected work, technical interests, and recent posts on X.
- [Writing](https://shirkerohit.github.io/writing): Field notes on software architecture, AI systems, and practical engineering decisions.
- [Bookshelf](https://shirkerohit.github.io/bookshelf): Books on programming, databases, distributed systems, and personal development.
- [Projects](https://shirkerohit.github.io/projects): Applications and developer tools, including a local-first expense tracker.

## Focus areas

- LLM applications and evaluation pipelines
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Agentic workflows and orchestration
- System architecture, microservices, and distributed systems
- Backend engineering, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
- Developer experience and practical tooling

## Machine-readable feeds

- [Medium articles (JSON)](https://medium-api-worker.rohitsh.workers.dev/): Recent articles with titles, links, categories, publication dates, and images.
- [X posts (JSON)](https://x-feed-worker.rohitsh.workers.dev/): Recent public posts with quoted context and IST timestamps.
